title: One more statement
description: Rate your agreement with the statement below (1 = strongly disagree, 7 = strongly agree).

metadata.scale: 7-point Likert, matching control_steer_effort so it reads as part of the battery
metadata.note: Scored by exact match on `correct_response`. The target is a NON-EXTREME value on purpose: a participant straight-lining 1s or 7s fails, which an 'always pick strongly disagree' check would not catch.

items.prompt: This question checks that you are still reading. Please select 2 (“Disagree”) for this item.
